name: Expropriate
clause: For each money vote, choose a permanent owned by the voter and gain control of it.

needs.proposedSignature: `{ op: 'vote', resolve: 'per-vote' }` runs each option's effects once per vote WITH the voter bound: `item.triggeringPlayer` (so `that-player` names them) and `item.actor` inside a `scoped who: 'that-player'` block; add `{ filter: { ownedBy: 'that-player' } }` so an object set can be narrowed to the voter's own permanents
needs.semantics: 'For each money vote, choose a permanent owned by the voter and gain control of it.' Council's dilemma cards pay out per vote and the payout is about the player who cast it; today the per-vote loop in src/engine/ops/piles-choices.ts re-applies the option's effects as the item's controller with no record of the voter, so 'owned by the voter' has no word.
needs.clause: For each money vote, choose a permanent owned by the voter and gain control of it.
